purpose: Show genuine model and patient contact timing; explain event-distribution fitting, not a paired-event waveform loss.

model.subject: epilepsiae_1146
model.signal: Gaussian contact average of E-spike counts in 2-ms bins, Gaussian temporal sigma=5 ms; no voltage forward model.
model.TFR_input: Unfiltered frozen firing-density trace, NOT its 30-80 Hz plotting derivative.
model.existing_A_markers: Peaks of the 30-80 Hz derivative at 76/68/62 ms in the 4310-4430 ms crop; neither observer centroid nor TFR centroid.
model.spectrum_limit: Temporal smoothing and pulse shape dominate this low-frequency rate spectrum. It does not establish a model HFO oscillation.

patient.subject: epilepsiae_1146
patient.source_signal: Actual SEEG: CAR, 50/100/150/200/250-Hz notch, 80-250-Hz bandpass; frozen 250-ms band_tile.
patient.membership: Exact event ID in the 30049-event development target. Do not infer membership of the later 19770-event FIT split from this alone.
patient.selection: Reuse previously selected Fig2 TA exemplar; not selected here for closest model similarity.
patient.previous_cache_centroid: Peak enhancement connected-component centroid, threshold 0.70. Not reused as the new S^3 centroid.
patient.original_fitting_centroid: Legacy lagPatRaw S^3 time-frequency centroid on a stitched event timeline; stored seconds converted to milliseconds. Its rank is preserved.

fitting_marker_time_recovery.rule: Original producer selects inclusive sample endpoints, stitches packed tiles per 200-s segment. Sum preceding tile sample counts / 1024, subtract this from stored fitting centroid; then subtract 125 ms for centered display.
fitting_marker_time_recovery.legacy_code_boundary: The legacy source has a 500-ms default, but these actual packed artifacts are 250 ms. Window size is taken from artifacts, not the legacy default.

TFR.algorithm: magnitude STFT, Hamming 50 ms, 80% overlap, nfft=nperseg, constant detrend; Gaussian sigma=1.5 in frequency/time bins BEFORE crop; W=S^3.
TFR.normalization: Each channel/event magnitude divided by its own maximum; not power or cross-contact amplitude.
TFR.time_origin: Each 250-ms event window center; no channel-specific shifts, no event-specific time stretch.
TFR.relation_to_current_Fig1: Same full-window S^3 rule, but isolated 250-ms tiles rather than full stitched preprocessing segments; newly derived display, not exact legacy lagPatRaw replay.
TFR.marker_legend: Legend omitted on canvas per author. Amber circle: newly calculated full-tile S^3 TFR centroid. Black top tick: stored timing used for rank. Thin amber lines connect adjacent contacts only within the same shaft.

rank.display: Original fitting-readout rank among all 15 participating contacts, 1-based; all 15 contacts shown in SCL9–6 then ICL11–1 anatomical shaft order. Not reranked in this subset.

loss.scales: Frozen positive medians of squared embedding distances in patient CAL draws of 16 events; never re-estimated from this example.
loss.feature_map: Frozen multiscale random Fourier features; rank/participation additionally include linear features; timing includes within-ICL, within-SCL and intershaft delays.
loss.J_joint_role: Offline joint-feature diagnostic for xy_left_20, NOT its optimization loss. Later stages 13-16 jointly optimize J and J_joint.
loss.current_panel_mapping: F: optimization progress; G: actual loss profiles; H: position density; I: actual loss components and total J
loss.display_error_definition: Each error first averages absolute model-patient differences within SCL and ICL, then averages the two shafts equally. Rank: conditional participating normalized mean ranks; order: within-shaft co-participating pair precedence probabilities; participation: contact participation probabilities.
loss.statistical_unit: A full 60-s native trajectory (151 eligible events after 1500-ms burnin), not the one illustrated event; comparator is the frozen patient FIT event distribution.
loss.stages: 1-5 label-conditioned development; 6-12 label-free J; 13-16 J and J_joint multiobjective. No single sum of the three displayed errors is the universal optimization objective.
loss.caption_formula: L_g(x_hat_g,x_g) = D_off,g/s_g; Loss = J = (L_r + L_o + L_p)/3. Same component definitions and symbols in C/G/I.

display_symbol_definitions.hat: Model event-level readouts; unhatted quantities are patient FIT readouts
display_symbol_definitions.r: Rank-related readout distribution, fitted using frozen rank_pattern features
display_symbol_definitions.o: Order/timing readout distribution, fitted using frozen local_and_interrod_timing features including within- and between-shaft timing
display_symbol_definitions.p: Participation readout distribution, fitted using frozen participation features
display_symbol_definitions.L_g: Actual normalized training component; same definition and r/o/p colors in G/I.

loss.display_errors_role: Historical auxiliary MAEs retained in source metadata only; no longer plotted in C/G/I.

display_revision: A left vertical curly brace groups the three unchanged training-loss terms; no right bracket; leading plus signs on rows two and three.
